item.title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins, tokenization
item.description: SBI Solana Global plans to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure, explore AI agent micropayments and tokenize financial assets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Hong Kong launches tokenized debt platform with 24-hour settlement
item.description: The HKMA’s new platform supports settlement in multiple currencies and handles debt issuance, interest payments and repayment at maturity.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs near $5B in record monthly outflows amid AI stock rout
item.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded $4.94 billion in November net outflows, exceeding the previous monthly record of $4.51 billion set in June.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Bitcoin price may fall below $53K if bear-market history repeats
item.description: Bitcoin price downside targets focused on the $53,200 realized price as research saw pointed to bear-market patterns continuing for BTC/USD.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: HYPE drops 8% as Trump bump gives way to 40% slide from peak
item.description: HYPE traded below its price before Trump’s August remarks as wallets linked to Abraxas Capital reportedly exited the Hyperliquid platform.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: French Senate rejects 100K euro crypto wallet disclosure requirement
item.description: Senators also rejected stablecoin-swap and crypto exit-tax proposals, while the 2027 budget remains under parliamentary consideration.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Stablecoin redemptions hit $12B in 30 days, echoing 2022 bear market
item.description: Crypto research firm Kaiko said the cash-out was smaller than in 2022 and has slowed, with stablecoin supply down just 0.4% since Nov. 13.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: EU seeks up to $55B for AI and quantum computing fund: Report
item.description: Hackers already use AI to target crypto exchanges, while future quantum computers could break the cryptography that protects users’ funds.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: South Korea’s crypto bill could move stablecoin race beyond token issuance
item.description: South Korea’s draft bill favors bank-led stablecoin issuance but allows fintech and technology companies to become the largest individual shareholders.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Solana DEX Velocity halts trading over bug just months after relaunch
item.description: Velocity relaunched in September as a rebuilt version of Drift Protocol, which was attacked by North Korean hackers in April.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Trump willing to pardon Jensen Huang, says it won’t be necessary
item.description: The president’s remarks come days before Jensen Huang is due to face congressional questioning over national security concerns and US chip export controls.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: CleanSpark weighs selling more Bitcoin than it mines to de-risk books
item.description: The Bitcoin miner sold 2,102 BTC while it produced just 1,708 BTC in the September quarter.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Hackers breach CIA intelligence network in latest US cyberattack
item.description: The reported breach follows cyber incidents involving the FBI, Department of Homeland Security and Department of Agriculture.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Europol follows $28.5M crypto trail in streaming piracy crackdown
item.description: Authorities from 11 countries worked with Binance, Coinbase and Chainalysis to trace financial transactions and disrupt illegal streaming services.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Utah moves to dismiss criminal charges against Kalshi after trading halt
item.description: Utah’s attorney general warned that the criminal charges could be refiled if Kalshi resumes operations in the state, while separate civil litigation remains unresolved.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin sell-off driven by weak demand, forced liquidations: 21Shares
item.description: The crypto asset manager warned that Bitcoin’s downturn could persist amid weak investor demand, while forecasting an uneven recovery across crypto sectors.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Coldcard reveals how Bitcoin wallet flaw went undetected for over 5 years
item.description: Coldcard maker Coinkite explained why years of security checks failed to catch the flaw and said it has yet to decide on compensation for affected customers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: CFTC sets new prediction market rules as more firms seek US entry
item.description: The US regulator has approved permanent reporting rules for certain event contracts as more companies look to launch prediction markets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market fund accepting stablecoins in Hong Kong
item.description: The tokenized fund launched with approximately $100 million in assets, with Standard Chartered and Ant International participating as seed investors.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin slides amid US tariff nerves as Anthropic falls below IPO price
item.description: Bitcoin gave up gains above $60,000 as tariff concerns weighed on US stocks and Anthropic shares hit new lows below $76.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: How South Korea’s proposed 20% cap could change who runs Upbit
item.description: Naver Financial agreed to buy every share in Upbit’s operator, but a proposed ownership cap could strip away its voting rights on four-fifths of them.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Adrian Zmudzinski

item.title: USDT buyers face 22% VAT when Moscow Exchange opens crypto trading
item.description: Buyers will pay VAT on top of the trade price in December because Russia’s tax code has no explicit exemption for foreign digital instruments.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Swiss central bank, UBS and SIX study ledger for tokenized settlement
item.description: The study will assess whether a shared ledger can bring central bank money, commercial bank money and securities onto the same platform.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Sky lender proposes buyback of up to $50M to fund stUSDS withdrawals
item.description: Borrowers would sell SKY to the protocol and use the proceeds to pay down their loans, freeing up funds for depositors in the stUSDS pool.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Grayscale calls Bitcoin ‘oversold’ at $62K but warns of AI risks
item.description: Grayscale said Bitcoin’s bear market was its longest on record at 411 days and counting, though the 56% drop was the smallest percentage decline.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: South Korea proposes bank-led stablecoins, 20% cap on crypto exchange stakes
item.description: The draft bill would also reopen domestic initial coin offerings after a ban dating to 2017 and require issuers to disclose risks before soliciting buyers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin dipped on Huang’s Nvidia exit but jumped 5% on his return
item.description: Bitcoin rose about 5% on Jensen Huang’s return, more than the 3.5% it lost on news of his exit, but remained 19.2% below its pre-resignation price.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin dips back under $60K as gold seals worst 60-day loss since 1980s
item.description: Bitcoin continued to threaten the loss of $60,000 support as gold attempted to bounce from a 60-day losing streak during which it fell nearly 25%.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs keep bleeding as BlackRock’s IBIT shares gain nearly 5%
item.description: BlackRock’s IBIT shares gained 4.85% on Monday despite continued Bitcoin ETF withdrawals that pushed November’s net outflows to $4.71 billion.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
